0022600104.text: The Charlotte Hornets (1-0, 3rd in the Southeast and 6th in the East) host the Miami Heat (0-1, 5th in the Southeast, 1 game back, and 15th in the East) in the Hornets' third game of the 2026-27 season. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery), all listed as out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after the Hornets lost the 2025-26 series 1-3, though Charlotte won the most recent meeting 136-106 in Charlotte on March 17, 2026, in a regular season game.
